name: percena
description: Percena marketplace: Lattice workflow skills and the Claude Code lattice plugin. Portable skills live under skills/; the plugin adds packaging and optional hooks.

plugins.name: lattice
plugins.description: Full Lattice loop for Claude: start-work, create-spec, create-review, create-tickets, batch-work, create-pr, finish-work, _lattice-lib, create-adr, run-e2e, and review-code/review-production side-paths. Optional hooks advise on bare gh pr create/merge; strict mode opts into marker gates.
